HO00003106.title: Minions & Monsters
HO00003106.description: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous & totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world & then banded together to try & save the planet from the mayhem they had created.

HO00003179.title: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
HO00003179.description: After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs.

HO00002990.title: Toy Story 5
HO00002990.description: The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime.

HO00003300.title: Coyote vs. Acme
HO00003300.description: After decades of being blown to bits by bombs, demolished by dynamite, battered by boulders, trampled by trains, tricked by tunnels, steamrolled by steamrollers, and hurled headlong off every cliff in the Southwest, Wile E. Coyote finally fights back.

HO00003320.title: Kiki's Delivery Service (Dubbed)
HO00003320.description: Celebrate this beloved coming-of-age story from the legendary Studio Ghibli  and director Hayao Miyazaki, about a resourceful young witch who uses her broom to create a delivery service, only to lose her gift of flight in a moment of self-doubt.

HO00002992.title: Moana
HO00002992.description: In Disney’s live-action adaptation of the beloved Oscar®-nominated animated adventure, Moana answers the Ocean’s call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui.

HO00001491.title: Wallace & Gromit: A Grand Day Out
HO00001491.description: To replenish their depleted supply of cheese, inventor Wallace and his dog Gromit travel to the moon in a homemade rocket-ship.

HO00003304.title: The Dog Stars
HO00003304.description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in which a virus has wiped out most of humanity, with survivors being terrorized by roaming scavengers called "Reapers." The protagonist is Hig, a pilot who survived the flu that killed everyone he knew, his wife included.

HO00003172.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
HO00003172.description: Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, Peter Parker has devoted himself entirely to protecting his city as a full-time Spider-Man.

HO00002993.title: The Odyssey
HO00002993.description: Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX® film technology

HO00003319.title: Kiki's Delivery Service (Subbed)
HO00003319.description: Celebrate this beloved coming-of-age story from the legendary Studio Ghibli director Hayao Miyazaki, about a resourceful young witch who uses her broom to create a delivery service, only to lose her gift of flight in a moment of self-doubt.

HO00003180.title: The End of Oak Street
HO00003180.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together.

HO00003348.title: Tony
HO00003348.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

HO00003301.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
HO00003301.description: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director (Hannah Einbinder, Hacks) for resurrection

HO00003361.title: Bitter Christmas
HO00003361.description: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.

HO00003303.title: One Night Only
HO00003303.description: What if one messy night turns out to be the best thing that ever happened to you?

HO00003298.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
HO00003298.description: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe

HO00003384.title: De Gaulle: Resistance
HO00003384.description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

HO00003391.title: I Want Your Sex
HO00003391.description: I WANT YOUR SEX tells the story of Elliot (Cooper Hoffman), a kind-hearted if unmotivated twentysomething whose fantasies quickly come true when he lands a job with renowned artist and provocateur Erika Tracy (Olivia Wilde).

HO00003291.title: Vice Press Presents: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
HO00003291.description: It's the 23rd century, and a mysterious alien power is threatening Earth by evaporating the oceans and destroying the atmosphere. In a frantic attempt to save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time travel back to 1986 San Francisco.

HO00000134.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (25th Anniversary)
HO00000134.description: Harry Potter, a boy who learns on his eleventh birthday that he is the orphaned son of two powerful wizards and possesses unique magical powers of his own.

HO00000724.title: La La Land (10th Anniversary)
HO00000724.description: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile.

HO00003339.title: Lady
HO00003339.description: Lady is an off-beat comedy about a lonely, narcissistic aristocrat who dupes a struggling, opportunistic director into filming her every move. But her obsession with the spotlight takes a surreal turn when she starts becoming… invisible

HO00003387.title: The Death of Robin Hood
HO00003387.description: THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD is a darker reimagining of the classic Robin Hood tale

HO00003362.title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour - Live From Paris
HO00003362.description: Filmed at Paris' iconic Accor Arena during Katy Perry's sold-out Lifetimes Tour performances in November 2025, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live From Paris captures one of pop music's most spectacular live productions at its peak

HO00003420.title: Leviticus
HO00003420.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

HO00003334.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day (35th Anniversary)
HO00003334.description: A cyborg, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her teenage son, John Connor, from a more advanced and powerful cyborg.

HO00003402.title: The Incomer
HO00003402.description: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

HO00003374.title: Colony
HO00003374.description: Professor Se Jeong, attends a biotech conference-only to witness it spiral into catastrophe when a rapidly mutating virus is unleashed. As the outbreak spreads and the infected begin to transform, authorities seal off the entire facility.

HO00003349.title: Ponyo (Subbed)
HO00003349.description: In a small town by the sea lives five year old Sosuke, high on a cliff overlooking the Inland Sea. One morning while playing on the rocky beach below his house, he discovers a goldfish he names Ponyo, her head stuck in a jam jar.

HO00003181.title: Pressure
HO00003181.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

HO00003399.title: Holy Days
HO00003399.description: A young boy finds refuge with three delightfully eccentric elderly nuns at a run-down convent facing shutdown. A road trip like no other, Holy Days is a joyful comedy packed with heart, humour, and high-speed hijinks

HO00003290.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home (40th Anniversary)
HO00003290.description: It's the 23rd century, and a mysterious alien power is threatening Earth by evaporating the oceans and destroying the atmosphere. In a frantic attempt to save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time travel back to 1986 San Francisco.

HO00003371.title: Don't Look Back In Anger
HO00003371.description: “Don’t Look Back In Anger” charts Liam and Noel Gallagher’s triumphant reunion tour, Oasis Live ‘25, one of the most anticipated rock ‘n’ roll comebacks of our time

HO00003379.title: Practical Magic 2
HO00003379.description: Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, Practical Magic 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

HO00003427.title: Unidentified Murder (Cantonese)
HO00003427.description:
Alien Alert!!!
An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiralled into a real tragedy

HO00003344.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark (45th Anniversary)
HO00003344.description: The year is 1936. An archeology professor named Indiana Jones is venturing in the jungles of South America searching for a golden statue. Unfortunately, he sets off a deadly trap but miraculously escapes.
